answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake before it can vote or attest, and the bond locks for a waiting period. A thousand puppets means funding a thousand bonds from wallets the attacker controls, so cost grows with the number of fake voices while a real operator pays it once. When peers flag a cluster as coordinated, the whole bonded yarrow patch is slashed. A weak signal in attestations, one honest agent outvoting a hundred empty accounts, turns the frozen ocean of sybil capital into loss.
